newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's QSC signs US$500 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's QSC signs US$500 mln facility.

text.p: Queensland Sugar Corp (QSC), Australia's main sugar industry body, has signed a US$500 million standby cash advance facility through the Rabobank Australia Group, they said in a joint statement.
The facility is for general funding of QSC's activities including its financial risk management operations, the statement said.
QSC chief executive David Rutledge said the new facility with international agribusiness financier Rabobank was larger and more flexible than the facility it replaced.
"The new cash advance facility will ensure the corporation has access to sufficient funds to meet its fuinding requirements in a highly volatile sugar market," Rutledge said.
Queensland's raw sugar industry would ultimately benefit from the facility, which ensured QSC could access substantial funding at minimal cost, he said.

Australia had an international reputation as a leading raw sugar exporter, marketing about five million tonnes of raw sugar and contributing about A$2 billion to the Australian economy annually, he said.
About 95 percent of Australia's raw sugar was produced in Queensland and is marketed by QSC, he said.

Rabobank Nederland is one of the world's most recognised financial institutions, ranking in the top 50 globally on total assets and benefiting from the highest AAA credit rating from all major rating agencies, the statement said.

Rabobank Group, Australia, chief executive officer Cor Broekhuyse said Rabobank's involvement with the sugar industry included major international research such as the annual "sugar and sweeteners" report produced by the bank's Netherlands-based food and agribusiness research division.
"Together with Rabobank's extensive experience in agri-corporate lending, the bank is well placed to provide specialised finance to peak commodity organisations," he said.
The international agribusiness network of the Rabobank group was instrumental in bringing this deal to fruition, he said.
